Subject: VegaCorp - Vendor questionnaire initiation and clarifying scope (SOC 2 / GDPR / HIPAA)

Hi Jenna / Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier today — great to meet the VegaCorp security and solutions team. Per our discussion, attaching a short prefill and the sig asks we typically see to accelerate your intake. A few clarifying items from our side before Monica/Rishi start pre-filling the SIG template:  

1) SOC 2 status and scope: can you confirm whether VegaCorp has a current SOC 2 Type II report and, if so, the covered services and most recent report date? If there is a bridge letter or exception list, please flag.

2) Data classification / residency: you mentioned a mix of PII and aggregated telemetry. For the initial evaluation, can you confirm whether any customer data we would process on your behalf is considered PHI (HIPAA) or subject to EU data subject protections (GDPR)? If some data is EU-only, do you require processing inside EU regions?

3) Expected questionnaire type: would you prefer the SIG-Lite, full SIG, or your custom vendor form? We can prefill SIG-Lite answers quickly; full SIG or CAIQ takes longer.

4) Evidence cadence and owners: please confirm a target date for returning the questionnaire and who on your side will own evidence collection (e.g., Jenna for security artifacts, procurement for contractual items).

Monica — looping you and Rishi to own the pre-fill. Rishi, if VegaCorp indicates PHI/HIPAA applicability we should include our compliance owner in the thread (Monica, can you confirm next steps on evidence if HIPAA applies?).

Next steps I propose: VegaCorp confirms SOC 2 + data classification today/tomorrow, VegaCorp picks SIG variant, Redwood returns prefills + evidence list within 48 business hours.

Thanks — Vivek

--

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the recap and the template. Quick answers inline:  

1) SOC 2: Yes — we have a SOC 2 Type II for our core data platform (period 2025-09). I can share the report under NDA; procurement will handle the download link.

2) Data classification/residency: VegaCorp handles both PII and some regulated healthcare leads. For this pilot, we expect only non-PHI customer metadata to be sent to Redwood, but scoped PII (name, email) will be present. GDPR applies to EU-based customers; we prefer EU processing for EU data when feasible.

3) Questionnaire type: procurement prefers SIG-Lite to start; security can request the full SIG if any gaps appear. Can you prefill SIG-Lite?

4) Owners: I'll own the security review and evidence coordination. Procurement (<procurement@vegacorp.com>) will handle contract redlines and DocuSign. Target turnaround: we aim to return the completed SIG-Lite within 5 business days.

I've attached our standard SIG template and a procurement intake PDF for reference (see attachment: VegaCorp_SIG_Template_20260625.pdf).

Samir, feel free to add anything on the tooling side if you think we need additional scoping.

Best,
Jenna

Subject: Re: VegaCorp - Vendor questionnaire initiation and clarifying scope (SOC 2 / GDPR / HIPAA)

Thanks Jenna — super helpful. Monica / Rishi have started a prefill and we attached the working sheet. Couple follow-up clarification requests before we finalize the prefill:  

A) PHI / HIPAA: you indicated the pilot expects non-PHI; to ensure our compliance owners sign off, can you confirm in writing that no PHI will be transmitted or stored by Redwood for the pilot? If any downstream use of email content is possible, please note it now.

B) EU processing: can you list which EU countries' data must remain in-region (if any)? We support EU regions but need to know residency requirements to map to our deployment options.

C) Least privilege & customer separation: for the SIG-Lite prefill, we typically provide the names of teams with production access (infra/runtime team, platform ops). Would you like us to include full org-level roles or redact names and provide role descriptions?

D) Evidence: for the SOC 2 evidence, procurement will likely request the report + any current remediation tracker. We can share a compressed evidence package; confirm whether you need encrypted transfer (SFTP) or a secured Drive link.

E) Timeline: you mentioned 5 business days to return; to meet that comfortably we will aim to send the prefill and evidence list by end of day Monday (2026-06-29). Does that work?

If all good, Monica will attach Redwood_prefill_SIG_answers_vegacorp_20260625.xlsx and send.

Cheers — Vivek

Vivek / Monica / Rishi —

All good on our end. Short answers:  

A) PHI/HIPAA: Confirmed — no PHI will be included in the pilot. Any email content will be limited to non-sensitive metadata and will not include protected health information.

B) EU processing: We have EU customers in Germany and Ireland; preferred processing in EU regions for those tenants, but initial pilot can run in US region with sanitized/test data. We will flag production EU data if/when the pilot expands.

C) Access controls: role descriptions are fine (no need for individual names). Please include platform ops, infra/runtime, and SRE as role descriptions in the prefill.

D) Evidence transfer: SFTP for SOC 2 artifacts is preferred; procurement will provide credentials if needed. Otherwise a secured Drive link with restricted access is acceptable.

E) Timeline: 2026-06-29 EOD for the prefill works. We'll aim to return the completed SIG-Lite by 2026-07-06.

I'll upload the signed procurement intake and the SIG template to the SharePoint link in procurement's ticket and loop procurement for the DocuSign step.

Thanks — Jenna
